definitions.explanation: The angular distance east of the prime meridian, measured in degrees. Used to specify locations east of the prime meridian (Greenwich).

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{東経|とうけい}139⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}している→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧。
examples.english: Tokyo is located at 139 degrees east longitude.

examples.japanese: {東経|とうけい}135⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{標準時|ひょうじゅんじ}→標準時：18871_hyoujunji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧だ。
examples.english: 135 degrees east longitude is the basis for Japan Standard Time.
This island is located at 150 degrees east longitude and 35 degrees north latitude.

notes:
{東経|とうけい} is the opposite of ⟦{西経|せいけい}→西経：26196_seikei⟧ (west longitude).

FORMS:
{東|とう} (east) + {経|けい} (longitude) = east longitude

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{西経|せいけい}→西経：26196_seikei⟧: west longitude
- {北緯|ほくい}: north latitude
- {南緯|なんい}: south latitude
- ⟦{経度|けいど}→経度：00209_keido⟧: longitude
- ⟦{緯度|いど}→緯度：03978_ido⟧: latitude
- {本初|ほんしょ}⟦{子午線|しごせん}→子午線：26054_shigosen⟧: prime meridian

USAGE:
Typically expressed as {東経|とうけい}〜⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (〜 degrees east longitude).
